title: Select assets on expand orders, or expand adjudication

issues.title: Select assets on expand orders, or expand adjudication
issues.body:
The concept of showing orders/assets when the orders/adjudication is opened is different to the existing `selecetedAssetss` and `selectedOrders`

I _guess_ we need two lists, because clicking on an asset only adds them to the `selected` list - not the list for `current orders`.

So, `selected` and `current`.

Aaah, that's it. When we expand a panel for orders/adjudication we set the `current` to the assets/orders for that message - replacing what was there before.  We don't change the `selected` state.

In `PlanningChannel` we will introduce `currentAssets` and `currentOrders`, with `setCurrentAssets` and `setCurrentOrders`. (arrays of strings of `Asset['uniqid']`

`setXXX` will be passed to `PlanningOrders`.  When a `planningOrders` detail is opened, the `MessagePlanning._id` will be passed to `setCurrentOrders`, and the `message.ownAssets` and `message.otherAssets` will be combined, and passed to `setCurrentAssets` (replacing the current object contents).   When a `planningOrders` detail is closed, the `setCurrentAssets` and `setCurrentOrders` will be set to `[]`

In PlanningChannel, `MapPlanningOrders` will receive the `currentOrders`, and plot any orders either in `selectedOrders` or `currentOrders`

In PlanningChannel we will introduce a `currentOwnAssets` and `currentOppAssets` (arrays of string ids).
We will introduce a useEffect the listens for changes in `currentAssets`.  The new `currentOwnAssets` will be filtered to `allOwnAssets.includes(id)`. The new `currentOppAssets` will be filtered to `allOppAssets.includes(id)`.
The two LayerGroup components in `PlanningChannel` will both get new `currentAssets` prop, that receive `currentOwnAssets` and `currentOppAssets` objects.

In the `PlanningForce` component, it will show an asset as selected if it is in either `selectedAssets` or `currentAssets`.
